隐私政策

生效日期：2026 年 9 月 24 日

Writer 没有账号，不做统计，不投广告，也不追踪你。你的文档只在你自己的电脑 上处理，我们收不到。

适用范围

本政策适用于 Writer 应用（Mac 版和 Windows 版）和本网站。Writer 由 Auspex（北京奥斯佩克斯网络科技中心）开发和运营，下文称“我们”。

我们不收集的信息

  • Writer 不需要注册或登录，没有账号。
  • 应用里没有统计、分析、广告或追踪代码，不会把你的使用情况发给我们。
  • 你的文档在你的电脑 上打开、编辑和保存，不会上传给我们。

文档在本机处理

  • Writer 的文档引擎运行在你的电脑 上，只接受来自本机（127.0.0.1）的连接，同一网络里的其他设备无法访问。
  • 抠图使用 macOS 自带的 Vision 框架在本机完成，图片不会上传。

AI 助手

  • AI 助手默认不启用。只有你在「设置 › AI」里填写了自己的模型服务（服务商、接口地址和 API Key）之后，才能使用。
  • 使用时，你发给助手的内容，也就是你的提问和完成这次任务所需的文档内容，会从你的电脑 直接发送到你选择的服务商，不经过我们，我们也收不到。服务商如何处理这些内容，适用该服务商自己的条款和隐私政策。
  • 如果你选择 Ollama、LM Studio 等运行在本机的模型，这些内容不会离开你的电脑。
  • 助手可以联网搜索和打开网页：搜索时，搜索词从你的电脑 直接发给必应（Bing）；打开网页时，由你的电脑 直接访问那个网站。这些请求都不经过我们。不需要的话，可以在设置里关掉「联网搜索」。
  • API Key 只保存在你的电脑上：Mac 上是 ~/Library/Application Support/Writer/ai.json，Windows 上是 %APPDATA%\Writer\ai.json，只有你的用户账户可以读取。

本网站

  • 本网站只用于介绍 Writer 和提供安装包下载，不使用 Cookie，不做访问统计，也不加载任何第三方的字体、脚本或图片。
  • 网站服务器位于中国内地（阿里云，北京），不记录访问日志。

你的数据由你掌控

  • 我们不持有你的任何个人信息，所以没有需要向我们申请查询、更正或删除的数据。
  • Writer 在你电脑上的设置和还没存储过的草稿保存在 ~/Library/Application Support/cn.thewriter.app（Windows：%APPDATA%\cn.thewriter.app），模型设置和 API Key 保存在 ~/Library/Application Support/Writer（Windows：%APPDATA%\Writer），删除这两个文件夹即可清除。你的文档由你自己保存和删除。

政策更新

如果本政策有变化，我们会更新本页面，并修改上方的生效日期。

联系我们

对本政策有任何疑问，请发邮件至 mosheng9@outlook.com。

Privacy Policy

Effective September 24, 2026

Writer has no accounts, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. Your documents are processed on your own computer, and we never receive them.

Scope

This policy covers the Writer app for Mac and Windows and this website. Writer is developed and operated by Auspex, registered in China as 北京奥斯佩克斯网络科技中心 (“we”).

What we don’t collect

  • There is no sign-up and no login. Writer has no accounts.
  • The app contains no analytics, advertising or tracking code and does not report how you use it.
  • Your documents are opened, edited and saved on your computer and are never uploaded to us.

On-device processing

  • Writer’s document engine runs on your computer and accepts connections only from the computer itself (127.0.0.1). Other devices on your network cannot reach it.
  • Background removal uses Apple’s on-device Vision framework. Images are not uploaded.

AI assistant

  • The assistant is off until you enter your own model service (provider, API base URL and API key) in Settings › AI.
  • When you use it, what you send (your request and the document content needed for the task) goes directly from your computer to the provider you chose. It does not pass through us and we never receive it. The provider handles it under its own terms and privacy policy.
  • With a model running on your computer, such as Ollama or LM Studio, this content never leaves your computer.
  • The assistant can search the web and open pages. Search words go from your computer directly to Bing, and your computer fetches each page directly from its site. None of this passes through us. You can turn web search (联网搜索) off in Settings.
  • Your API key is stored only on your computer, in ~/Library/Application Support/Writer/ai.json on a Mac or %APPDATA%\Writer\ai.json on Windows, readable only by your user account.

This website

  • The website introduces Writer and offers the installer. It uses no cookies and no analytics, and loads no third-party fonts, scripts or images.
  • It is hosted in mainland China (Alibaba Cloud, Beijing). The server keeps no access logs.

Your data

  • We hold no personal information about you, so there is nothing to request, correct or delete from us.
  • Writer’s settings and drafts you have not saved yet are in ~/Library/Application Support/cn.thewriter.app on a Mac (%APPDATA%\cn.thewriter.app on Windows), and model settings and your API key in ~/Library/Application Support/Writer (%APPDATA%\Writer on Windows). Delete these folders to remove them. Your documents are yours to keep or delete.

Changes

If this policy changes, we will update this page and the effective date above.

Contact

Questions about this policy: mosheng9@outlook.com.
